_comment: Known outages in tare's daily collection. Recorded so a flat or absent stretch in a chart can be told apart from a genuinely stable market. Dates listed under 'reconstructed' carry a matching 'reconstructed' block inside each snapshot file.

gaps.label: Hormuz / food crisis exposure
gaps.cause: The daily job ran but could not commit. A protect-main repository ruleset added on 2026-08-10 rejected the bot's push, and the failure was not surfaced for 18 days.
gaps.method: scripts/backfill-history.py replayed the series forward from the 2026-08-10 state. Exposure is path-dependent, so each day feeds the next rather than being computed in isolation.

inputs.oil_brent_usd: observed. FRED DCOILBRENTEU, queried per date, most recent observation at or before each day.
inputs.natural_gas_eur_mwh: held at the August level. Monthly World Bank series (PNGASEUROP) — exact for this window, not interpolated.
inputs.urea_usd_ton: held at the August level. Monthly World Bank series (PUREA).
inputs.methanol_usd_ton: held at the August level. Monthly World Bank series (PMETHANOL).

gaps.caveat: FRED publishes Brent with a short lag, so 2026-08-26 and 2026-08-27 carry the 2026-08-25 observation. The live job would have seen the same value on those days.

gaps.label: Red Sea / shipping exposure
gaps.reason: The Red Sea inputs are current-value only. The Drewry World Container Index is read from a published page that shows the latest weekly assessment, and the Freightos FBX endpoint returns present index levels. Neither exposes history, so there is no source from which these dates could be recovered.
gaps.decision: Left empty. Interpolating between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-28 would produce a plausible line that was never measured, which is the opposite of what this project is for.
